task_title: Polish abilities hotbar and selection UX

plan_review.notes: Rejected vague generic-picker restyle. Alt A dedicated AbilityLoadoutUI chosen to isolate ability management and preserve all ModalPicker callers. Alt B opt-in ModalPicker variant rejected because ability loadout input, scrolling, and row semantics would still complicate a one-shot generic picker. Alt C ui-probe-lab fixture rejected in favor of the real MainGameScene-backed abilities lab with stable design-space probes. Resolutions: pinned header/footer plus scroll viewport; canonical ability registry data; separate hotbar/play and picker/modal states; stable bounds only; viewport/input/occlusion coverage; deterministic geometry authoritative; repeated LLM findings require probe evidence.

escalated_to_human.reason: Round 2 was non-clean with remaining concerns; the 2-round cap requires human escalation. The round-3 entry recorded previously violated the bounded-loop policy (review-harness-policy.md:84-100) and has been removed.
